14. A repeat failing any check of stages (1) to (4) of A04 rule 6 is refused,
    is never answered as a repeat, and nothing changes: one from a service
    without the right (1); Kernel's after the project left its session's set
    (2); a room's on a project deleted whole since (3); one whose required
    value is now given blank, or a publish of a removed type (4).
   Shows A01-2. [witness: verification:registry_a01_repeat_failing_early_stage_refused]

verdicts.why: The selected test creates successful room, pointer, and project records, then verifies refusals at stages 1–4 for missing authentication/service rights, loss of session access, deletion of the project, blank required values, and a removed artifact type. The refusal helper proves these are not repeat answers, repeated store snapshots prove no refusal changes state, and the final cardinality/content checks detect extra room or pointer records.
